mapper.sql: id, laoren_id as laorenId, laoren_xingming as laorenXingming, xingbie, chusheng_riqi as chushengRiqi, nianling, shenfenzhenghao, lianxi_dianhua as lianxiDianhua, jiating_zhuzhi as jiatingZhuzhi, xuexing, guominshi, jiwangbingshi, huli_xuqiu as huliXuqiu, qiwang_ruzhu_shijian as qiwangRuzhuShijian, jiashu_xingming as jiashuXingming, jiashu_shouji as jiashuShouji, yu_laoren_guanxi as yuLaorenGuanxi, shenqing_zhuangtai as shenqingZhuangtai, coalesce(banli_zhuangtai, '未办理') as banliZhuangtai, shenhe_ren_id as shenheRenId, shenhe_ren_xingming as shenheRenXingming, shenhe_shijian as shenheShijian, shenhe_yijian as shenheYijian, beizhu, chuangjian_shijian as chuangjianShijian, gengxin_shijian as gengxinShijian
mapper.select:
select
from ruzhu_shenqing where shanchu_zhuangtai = '正常'
and laoren_xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
and jiashu_shouji like concat('%', #{jiashuShouji}, '%')
and shenqing_zhuangtai = #{shenqingZhuangtai}
order by chuangjian_shijian desc, id desc

select
from ruzhu_shenqing where id = #{id} and shanchu_zhuangtai = '正常'

select
from ruzhu_shenqing where shanchu_zhuangtai = '正常' and shenqing_zhuangtai = '已通过' and coalesce(banli_zhuangtai, '未办理') = '未办理' and laoren_id is not null
and laoren_xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
and jiashu_shouji like concat('%', #{jiashuShouji}, '%')
order by shenhe_shijian desc, id desc
mapper.update: update ruzhu_shenqing set shenqing_zhuangtai = #{shenqingZhuangtai}, shenhe_ren_id = #{shenheRenId}, shenhe_ren_xingming = #{shenheRenXingming}, shenhe_shijian = now(), shenhe_yijian = #{shenheYijian} where id = #{id}
update ruzhu_shenqing set laoren_id = #{laorenId}, banli_zhuangtai = coalesce(banli_zhuangtai, '未办理') where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id from laoren_xinxi where shenfenzheng = #{shenfenzheng} and ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into laoren_xinxi ( laoren_bianhao, xingming, xingbie, chusheng_riqi, nianling, shenfenzheng, xuexing, laoren_leixing, ruzhu_zhuangtai, lianxi_dianhua, jiating_zhuzhi, beizhu ) values ( #{laorenBianhao}, #{laorenXingming}, #{xingbie}, #{chushengRiqi}, #{nianling}, #{shenfenzhenghao}, #{xuexing}, #{laorenLeixing}, '未入住', #{lianxiDianhua}, #{jiatingZhuzhi}, concat_ws('；', nullif(concat('过敏史：', ifnull(#{guominshi}, '')), '过敏史：'), nullif(concat('既往病史：', ifnull(#{jiwangbingshi}, '')), '既往病史：'), nullif(concat('护理需求：', ifnull(#{huliXuqiu}, '')), '护理需求：'), nullif(#{beizhu}, '') ) )
mapper.update: update laoren_xinxi set xingbie = #{shenqing.xingbie}, chusheng_riqi = #{shenqing.chushengRiqi}, nianling = #{shenqing.nianling}, xuexing = #{shenqing.xuexing}, lianxi_dianhua = #{shenqing.lianxiDianhua}, jiating_zhuzhi = #{shenqing.jiatingZhuzhi}, beizhu = concat_ws('；', nullif(concat('过敏史：', ifnull(#{shenqing.guominshi}, '')), '过敏史：'), nullif(concat('既往病史：', ifnull(#{shenqing.jiwangbingshi}, '')), '既往病史：'), nullif(concat('护理需求：', ifnull(#{shenqing.huliXuqiu}, '')), '护理需求：'), nullif(#{shenqing.beizhu}, '') ) where id = #{laorenId}
